summary: Frontend-only regression for Air to Drive landing (iteration 5). Social-preview meta tags, favicons, LAUNCH25 promo flow, invalid-promo flow, install-prompt dismissal persistence, buy-button Stripe-unconfigured info toast, /success without session_id handling, and /about + /browse routes all pass on both desktop 1280x900 and mobile 390x844 after the app.json web.output='static' switch. CRITICAL BUG: EARLY50 renders $9.97 (expected $9.98) and FOUNDER renders $13.96 (expected $13.97) due to IEEE-754 floating-point rounding in `(BASE_PRICE * (1 - pct/100)).toFixed(2)` (19.95*0.5 = 9.9749999…, 19.95*0.7 = 13.9649999…). LAUNCH25 happens to be exact ($14.96) so it was not caught by iteration-4. No Expo deprecated-package issues, no SafeAreaView issues detected in the touched files.

ui_bugs.issue: Floating-point rounding error: EARLY50 shows $9.97 instead of $9.98, FOUNDER shows $13.96 instead of $13.97. 19.95 * 0.5 evaluates to 9.9749999999999996 and 19.95 * 0.7 to 13.964999999999998 in JS, so .toFixed(2) rounds down. Fails the review-request acceptance criteria 'EARLY50 -> $9.98; FOUNDER -> $13.97'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/landing/LandingPage.tsx:66 (`const discounted = (BASE_PRICE * (1 - (applied?.pct ?? 0) / 100)).toFixed(2);`).

action_items: Fix FP rounding in LandingPage.tsx:66. Suggested fix (integer-cent math): `const discounted = (Math.round(BASE_PRICE * 100 * (1 - (applied?.pct ?? 0) / 100)) / 100).toFixed(2);` — this will give LAUNCH25=$14.96, EARLY50=$9.98, FOUNDER=$13.97 as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.tsx:66 — Monetary calculations should always use integer cents (or a decimal lib) rather than Number * Number followed by toFixed, to avoid IEEE-754 drift. Current code only coincidentally produces the right value for 25% off.

LandingPage.tsx:49 — PROMO_CODES is defined at module scope with a static mapping. If codes are later moved server-side, consider sourcing them from the backend (`/api/checkout/config` or similar) so client bundle doesn't leak the full list and server can validate.

LandingPage.tsx:220-222 — strike/display uses `cfg.data?.amount_display ?? '$19.95'` for the base but a locally computed `$${discounted}` string for the discounted price; if the server ever changes `BASE_PRICE`, the two will go out of sync. Compute discounted from the configured base amount (or at minimum, keep BASE_PRICE as the single source of truth).

rca_of_issue: RCA — Floating-point drift in JS. 19.95 cannot be represented exactly in IEEE-754 double; it is stored as 19.949999999999999289… Multiplying by 0.5 gives 9.9749999999999996…, and by 0.7 gives 13.964999999999998. Number.prototype.toFixed truncates/rounds the decimal expansion of the actual float, so .toFixed(2) returns '9.97' and '13.96' instead of the mathematically correct '9.98' and '13.97'. LAUNCH25 (25% off) happens to land on a float that rounds correctly, which is why iteration 4 did not catch it. Reproduction: in any JS console run `(19.95 * 0.5).toFixed(2)` → '9.97', `(19.95 * 0.7).toFixed(2)` → '13.96'. Mitigation: switch to integer cents — `(Math.round(BASE_PRICE * 100 * (1 - pct/100)) / 100).toFixed(2)` — which rounds in the integer domain and is immune to this class of error.
